source_window: OS NGD Building Features Collection applications and attribution
finding: Official OS NGD Building Features Collection documentation states rich attribution supports querying by Building Use and that residential/commercial determination can use Building Use, Description or Address Count, with cross references to Address or Land Use. This collection-level documentation does not expose an individual project-bindable Building feature instance with exact footprint, OSID, buildinguse, UPRN linkage and canonical_parcel_id.
